<solution_file path="src/solution.py">
import pandas as pd

# Read input file
input_file = 'outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv'
output_report = 'outputs/t12_missingness_report.csv'
output_selected = 'outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv'

# Read the input file
df = pd.read_csv(input_file)

# Count missing values for each indicator
missing_data = df.isna().sum()
missing_rates = missing_data / len(df)

# Create the missingness report with required columns
report = pd.DataFrame({
    'indicator': df.columns.tolist(),
    'missing_count': missing_data,
    'missing_rate': missing_rates,
    'kept': missing_rates <= 0.30
})

# Write the missingness report
report.to_csv(output_report, index=False)

# Filter for indicators with missing_rate <= 0.30
filtered_df = report[report['kept']]

# Select only city_id, city_name, year, and keep indicators
output_selected[['city_id', 'city_name', 'year', 'indicator']].to_csv(output_selected, index=False)
</solution_file>
